questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How oil companies make money in Nigeria
Why rivers are becoming more polluted
A scientist who won a prize for inventing a new machine
Using plants to clean up polluted land and water
questions.why: Neil says they'll be hearing about plants that fight pollution.

questions.q: What is said about cleaning up chemical pollution in the usual way?
options: It is dangerous, costly and uses high-tech equipment
It is cheap but very slow
It is done only by local people
It has already cleaned most polluted places
questions.why: Beth says it is dangerous and expensive, and mostly involves highly technological equipment.

questions.q: Which example of natural cleaning is mentioned?
options: Trees that clean the air in cities
Water hyacinths that take up oil from rivers
Flowers that remove plastic from the sea
Grass that stops oil spills
questions.why: Neil says water hyacinths have been used to clean rivers by sucking up spilled oil.

questions.q: What has happened in the Niger Delta since oil was discovered?
options: Local people have become rich from the oil money
The land has been carefully protected by oil companies
Oil spills have ruined the land and caused mistrust
Most of the oil has now run out, so companies left
questions.why: Beth says oil spills have devastated the region and there is mistrust of the oil companies.

questions.q: Why did Eucharia Nwaichi win the Maddox Prize?
options: For showing courage in a dangerous place
For inventing a new way of drilling for oil
For writing a famous book about the Delta
For working closely with the oil companies
questions.why: The prize is for scientists showing courage in the face of hostility, and she worked despite personal risk.

questions.q: Why do local communities often distrust outsiders?
options: Outsiders don't speak their local language
Companies broke promises to clean up spills
Scientists took their land for experiments
They don't believe that plants can help
questions.why: Georgina says they have deep mistrust of outsiders after broken promises from companies.

questions.q: What does Eucharia do first when she starts working with a community?
options: She pays the young people to plant
She works only with the oil companies
She brings in scientists from London
She informs the community leaders of her plans
questions.why: She finds the chief, the women leader and the youth leader and informs them what she wants to do.

questions.q: According to Georgina Rannard, what is Eucharia's 'magic formula' based on?
options: Expensive technology and big budgets
Government support and new laws
Diplomacy, trust and charisma
Speed and hard work
questions.why: She says it relies on diplomacy, trust and charisma.
